name: demo-ts
description: Sol's TypeScript showcase: an order service and a fulfillment worker consuming the published @sol-fab/obs and @sol-fab/kafka packages from npm. This directory is deliberately its own npm project root (own package.json and package-lock.json, no dependence on an enclosing JavaScript workspace) -- it is the conformance fixture proving a Sol workspace can consume the published packages with nothing but the workspace itself. See DEC-023/DEC-024 and FEAT-085.
